messages.subject: fortify for gam binomial
parts:
Hi,
The 'fortify' function in ggplot2 works with a linear model but throws an error when using 'gam' binomial.
Question: is there a workaround to make it work with other type of models such as gam?

require(ggplot2)
mod <- lm(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars)
head(fortify(mod))

library(mgcv)
## simulate binomial data...
set.seed(0)
n.samp <- 400
dat <- gamSim(1,n=n.samp,dist="binary",scale=.33)
p <- binomial()$linkinv(dat$f) ## binomial p
n <- sample(c(1,3),n.samp,replace=TRUE) ## binomial n
dat$y <- rbinom(n,n,p)
dat$n <- n

lr.fit <- gam(y/n~s(x0)+s(x1)+s(x2)+s(x3)
             ,family=binomial,data=dat,weights=n,method="REML")

head(fortify(lr.fit))
